claims.text: Small tumors <1.5 cm: observation may be considered
claims.quote: Observation may be considered in patients with small tumors <1.5 cm, patients with multiple medical comorbidities, no growth, and stable symptoms.

claims.text: Larger and/or symptomatic: stereotactic radiosurgery or microsurgery
claims.quote: Larger and/or symptomatic tumors are treated with stereotactic radiosurgery or conventional microsurgery.
